note: Coverage only. No accuracy is reported here on purpose: a table mixing three-book and four-book artifacts compares two corpora, and that is the error this audit exists to surface.
limitations: A three-book artifact is not invalid; it measured what it measured. The defect is reading it as a light-novel result.
grimgar03 is 396 of 793 gold rows, and its base arm reads 89.1% against 68-75% for the others, so adding it raises any pooled figure for reasons unrelated to method.
